description: This file defines the NetworkService class, which manages network-related functionalities for a modem simulator, including handling radio power, signal strength, network registration, and operator info. It also declares related enums, data structures, and methods for network simulation.

classes.name: NetworkService
classes.description: A class that simulates network services for a modem, including handling network registration, signal strength, operator info, and radio state.

classes.name: NetworkService::SignalStrength
classes.description: Structure representing various signal strength metrics for different network types.

classes.name: NetworkService::NetworkOperator
classes.description: Structure representing network operator information and state.

classes.name: NetworkService::NetworkRegistrationStatus
classes.description: Structure representing network registration status, including mode, state, and network type.

classes.name: NetworkService::KeepSignalStrengthChangingLoop
classes.description: Inner class managing a loop to simulate changing signal strength over time.
